text:
Evan: morning! day 1 checklist and running into weird MFA/SSO things. 1Password invite showed up ~30min late, and Okta push to my phone never arrived. also tried enrolling a passkey on my MacBook (Ventura) and Safari says "Authenticator not available". any quick tips?
Kira (IT): welcome Evan :) can you confirm which email the invites were sent to (work vs personal)? Also ping me the device model for the phone and macOS version. For push issues, sometimes the Okta Push service is blocked by corporate mobile policies.
Evan: I accepted invites via evan.work+signup@gmail.com (i accidentally used personal alias). macbook is MacBook Pro 2020, macOS 13.5.2, phone is Pixel 6a Android 14.
Lisa (onboarding): note: if you accepted with an alias we usually map it automatically but sometimes it doesn't; @Kira can do a mapping and resend. Kira do you want me to hold off?
Kira (IT): i'll map the alias and resend 1Password. for the Okta push: can you open the Okta Verify app, go to Settings > Devices and check if the device shows up as "Pending"? also check the Android system notification settings haven't silenced Okta Verify.
Evan: Okta Verify settings show no pending devices. i cleared app cache and rebooted phone, still no push.
eng-infra: another possibility: if you tried enrollments from multiple browsers it can leave a stale transaction on Okta. Try clearing site data for the org URL and re-initiate the flow. Also make sure you're not behind a proxy that rewrites host headers.
Evan: cleared site data for okta.redwood.ai, retried, still nothing. any logs i can share?
Kira (IT): i see a failed push attempt in the admin console with status "no_device" tied to evan.work+signup@gmail.com. i'm mapping that alias to evan@redwood.ai now and resending. also enabling fallback TOTP enrollment for you.
onboarding-bot: 1Password invite resent to evan@redwood.ai at 1885001240.
Evan: 1Password invite arrived to work email, accepted. thanks. re: passkey on Mac, Safari gave "Authenticator not available" but Chrome prompted for Touch ID when i retried. so i enrolled as "evan-mac-passkey" in Chrome.
Kira (IT): good call on Chrome. Safari's WebAuthn support can be flaky with certain enterprise cookies. i've mapped your alias and you should get a new Okta push now. if push still fails, use the TOTP code or the passkey.
Evan: got the Okta push this time! looks like mapping fixed something. Question: is it normal for 1Password to be delayed? my invite was ~30min late even after resend.
Lisa (onboarding): sometimes the team console queue is slow if a bulk sync is running; rarely the mail provider flags the message. IT can always manual-invite or give temporary creds. i'll note the delay on the onboarding checklist.
Kira (IT): marking this resolved. quick follow-ups: we'll keep alias mapping in the checklist, prefer Chrome for initial passkey enrollments on macOS if Safari misbehaves, and if Okta push doesn't show check Okta Verify device list + clear site data. ping me if you need SSH key upload.
Evan: all set, 1Password, Okta (push + TOTP), passkey all working. ssh pubkey imported via 1Password and i can access the dev VM. thanks everyone! :tada:
Kira (IT): closing thread. :white_check_mark:
